costRounding: cost(n) = round(base x k^(n-1) / 5) x 5 (Math.round to nearest multiple of 5), for each resource independently; verified to reproduce every level of every building in the official calculator data. Exceptions: Embassy, Treasury, Hidden Treasury have a special level-1 cost (see costRule).

buildTimeRule.formula: shown = roundStep(timeBase x MB(m) / speed) x fealtyFactor; MB(m) = Main Building effect at level m = 0.964^(m-1), MB(0)=5; for Main Building itself m = target level - 1 (so MB level 1 uses factor 5)
buildTimeRule.roundStep: round to 5 s if <600 s, 30 s if <1800 s, 60 s if <7200 s, else 300 s
buildTimeRule.fealtyFactor: fealty>=11: x = 1 (fealty 11), 1.5 (12), fealty-11 (13-20), capped 9; +1 if prestige level >=11; factor = 1 - x/100; not applied to Wonder of the World
buildTimeRule.fealtyCostFactor: resource cost x (1 - (fealty<12 ? 0 : 0.5 x (fealty-11 + (prestige>=12 ? 1 : 0)))/100), rounded; not applied to WW
buildTimeRule.speedEffects: CP x speed; storage/cranny/healing capacity x {1:1,2:1.25,3:1.5,5:2,10:4}[speed]

notes: Primary data = official Travian Kingdoms building calculator (tk-kb.kingdoms.com, embedded as iframe in support article 59). It ships explicit per-level tables (cost, population, CP, base time, effects); levels[] are copied verbatim, k values were fitted and verified against all levels (derived:false because explicit tables exist).
levels[].pop and levels[].cp are totals at that level (calculator subtracts previous level for ranges); "supply" equals "population" for every level in the data.

Wall bonus VERIFIED for Kingdoms: defBonus = k^lvl - 1 with City Wall 1.03, Palisade 1.025, Earth Wall 1.02 (lvl20: 0.806/0.639/0.486). Walls additionally give flat defense 10/8/6 per level (City Wall/Palisade/Earth Wall). Natarian Wall = Earth Wall values.
Ram resistance (durability) of walls: NOT in official data or articles -> unknown. kirilloid T3 descriptions (City Wall 1x, Palisade 2x, Earth Wall 5x) are Legends/classic, not verified for Kingdoms.

Water Ditch: official calculator lists only prerequisite "City" - NO tribe restriction (refutes "Romans only"). Cannot be damaged by rams/catapults. Its defense bonus value is not in the data -> unknown. (kirilloid shows a % table for it via fallback code; not trusted.)
Resource fields: max level 20, but levels 11-12 only in a city or capital, 13-20 only in capital (levelCaps).

Cropland level-1 crop cost is 0 in Kingdoms (75/90/85/0); Warehouse crop cost 0 (140/180/100/0); Warehouse/Granary/Main Building/Rally Point/Barracks/Stable/Academy/Trapper/Embassy use k=1.33 (Legends uses 1.28).

Treasury/Hidden Treasury share identical cost tables; Treasury is not built directly - it is a Hidden Treasury activated by king/vice king/duke (needs treasury slot). Hidden Treasury cannot coexist with Treasury (NotBuilding 27) and not in WW village.
Great Barracks / Great Stable EXIST in Kingdoms but only in cities. Brewery (Teutons) exists: capital only, maxLevel 20. Horse Drinking Trough (Romans) and Trapper (Gauls) exist.
Kingdoms-specific: Water Ditch, Hidden Treasury, Treasury (treasures/kingdom), Healing Tent (heals 40% of eligible lost troops), Embassy holds oases (slots at lvl 1/10/20).

NOT in Kingdoms (absent from official calculator gid list): Blacksmith/Armoury split (gid 12; Kingdoms has Smithy gid 13), Hero's Mansion (gid 37; oases via Embassy), Hospital (Legends; Kingdoms has Healing Tent), Egyptian/Hun/Spartan/Viking buildings (Stone Wall, Makeshift Wall, Command Center, Waterworks, Harbor, Barricade, Defensive Wall...).
Teahouse (gid 44) appears in the official calculator with data identical to Brewery but has no help-center article; kept separately under unverifiedBuildings.
WW village rules (support art. 104): no Palace, no Treasury, Great Warehouse/Great Granary/Natarian Wall only there. WW costs are not capped at 1,000,000 in official data (kirilloid caps them).
Building times: timeBase is the raw value at speed 1 with MB factor 1; game display rounds (see buildTimeRule). Main Building level 1 itself uses factor 5 (MB level 0).
